findings.summary: Lean needs f, U smooth on an open, axis-star-shaped domain. Any such domain containing (X,η) also straddles X=0, and at η=±1 it reaches past the endpoints. The paper's profiles are C^∞ only on the closed [0,X_c]×[−1,1]. An extension is therefore needed at every point, not only at the boundary.

Lean writes the source integrands in regular form: X·H_X for H·l, H_η for H(log E)_η, and Px = f² for Π_X. It builds Π as pressure0(η) + ∫_0^X f². W uses average(∂ηU), which W_formula equates with ∂ηA_X(U). All of these match the paper's (4.9), (4.10) and (4.15) for X>0 and φ>0.
